html:
Enjoying Indian cuisine on Halong cruise will bring visitors exciting feelings, dishes prepared by talented chefs from India will bring diners a very unique delicious flavor, you should experience Halong cruise once to directly enjoy those delicious and attractive dishes today.

1. Tandoori chicken or fish

Chicken or fish marinated with yogurt, spices, ginger, garlic, cumin, coriander and turmeric, then processed by talented chefs and cooked in a clay oven with a smoky, spicy taste and bright red color called tandoor.

2. Beef kebab:

Beef skewers marinated with garam masala, chili powder and salt, grilled on charcoal or in a tandoor oven, when enjoying, diners eat with mint chili sauce or yogurt sauce, bringing a delicious flavor of their own.

3. Naan with Sweet Chutney:

Flat bread made from wheat flour, baked in a tandoor oven and then spread with butter or milk, chutney, and spices such as cardamom, cinnamon, and cloves to give diners an irresistible delicious taste.

4. Dal:

A delicious cone of lentils, water, oil, onions, garlic, ginger, tomatoes, and many spices such as cumin, mustard seeds, turmeric, and curry leaves… is one of the attractive dishes of Indian people.

5. Paneer:

A type of fresh cheese made from curdled milk with lemon juice or vinegar… it can be said that Paneer is enjoyed in many different forms including paneer tikka, paneer butter masala or palak paneer.

6. Biryani:

Indian festive dish includes fragrant rice cooked with meat, vegetables, nuts, dried fruits and spices such as saffron, cardamom, cloves and bay leaves. Biryani has many options such as chicken, lamb or vegetables…

In addition, Indian dishes must include vegetarian dishes, if you want to enjoy Indian vegetarian dishes, please contact the boat house in advance to enjoy dishes with Indian flavors

Therefore, Ha Long is increasingly chosen by many Indian tourists as a stopover to explore during their vacation, especially to experience on a 5-star cruise while enjoying delicious dishes with bold Indian flavors.

In addition to enjoying the cuisine, tourists can also live right on the cruise ship. Below are some beautiful virtual living spots on the 5-star cruise ship Ha Long.

The cruise ship’s deck

This is a virtual living spot chosen by many young people. From the deck, you can see the whole view of the sea and islands, especially the sunrise or sunset, the most magical and beautiful moments in the island paradise.

Swimming pool – Jacuzzi on the cruise ship Ha Long

Most cruise ships have swimming pools for tourists to relax. Many cruise ships also have large, beautiful swimming pools. You can relax or sit right next to the pool to admire the beautiful peaceful scenery.

The cruise ship’s balcony

This is one of the private spaces for you, you can both enjoy the scenery and record beautiful moments, especially when the cruise ship passes by the famous landmarks that you love. You can record beautiful moments with the nature of the sea and islands, a natural scene that cannot be found anywhere else.

Private bedroom on the cruise

You can take pictures to record your vacation time, in the rooms on the cruise all have large glass, from the room you can still record the moment at sea through the transparent glass.

Bathtub in the room

Where you have private space, but is the place chosen by many people to take pictures, especially in the Jacuzzi baths, soaking and watching the scenery through the glass, a peaceful space.

Kayaking

Is one of the activities chosen by many people, especially young people, when rowing through the scenic areas, rowing and watching the scenery will bring you the most enjoyable feeling. So it can be said that when experiencing Ha Long cruise, you not only enjoy delicious food but also save for yourself the most beautiful moments, or private spaces during your vacation in the island paradise.
